key_idea: A piece that covers another piece was put on the table later.
steps: The pink rectangle is under everything, so it went on first.
The blue triangle lies on the rectangle, and the yellow circle covers the middle of the triangle.
The green square lies on the circle, and the orange pentagon lies on the square.
From the bottom up: rectangle, triangle, circle, square, pentagon. The second piece is the triangle.

choice_feedback.A: The circle was the third piece. It lies on the triangle.
choice_feedback.B: The square was the fourth piece. It lies on the circle.
choice_feedback.D: The rectangle was the first piece, at the very bottom.
choice_feedback.E: The pentagon was the last piece, on top of all the others.
